messages:
Ava (PM): Heads up — we need to lock the MVP surface by EOD Friday for the Q2 launch planning. The big ask from Acme is the guaranteed 95ms median for embeddings on dedicated tier.
Sam (Eng): EOD Friday is tight. If we pin to the quantized-v2 model we can hit perf, but accuracy trade-offs for some tenant prompts.
Riley (SRE): 95ms median on Dedicated is doable if we reserve 2x the autoscale slots during peak. That impacts capacity cost.
Jordan (Design): Acme said they'll accept a degraded UX for long tail edge cases, but they need a deterministic SLA window.
Priya (Solutions): Customer committed to GA date in their contract. We need a gating plan — either feature-flagged default or soft-fallback to hosted model.
Ava (PM): Proposal: two-phase gate. Phase A (MVP): ship core flows with quantized-v2 pinned on dedicated for Acme. Phase B (v1): broaden to full model family with gradual rollout after regressed evals pass.
Sam (Eng): Questions:
- What are the criteria to move from Phase A -> Phase B?
- Who owns eval thresholds?
Jordan (Design): Eval threshold should include key UX prompts (signup, search, snippet). If latency improves but hallucination rate rises >2% we hold.
Riley (SRE): Operational criteria: error rate <0.5% and p99 < 450ms for the dedicated pool over 24h, plus autoscale headroom >= 15%.
Priya (Solutions): Customer requirement: 95ms median embeddings for tenant queries under 50k qps monthly. They want a fallback behaviour documented in the SLO appendix.
Ava (PM): I'll draft the gate checklist. Quick sketch: 
```
Phase A (MVP) gating checklist:
- Model: quantized-v2 pinned
- Customer median embeddings <=95ms (observed over 1h window)
- Evals: core-prompt-suite pass rate >=98%
- Ops: autoscale reservations configured, runbook linked
- Contract: documented fallback and customer notification cadence
```
Sam (Eng): Can we add an autoslice rule that routes Acme traffic to dedicated until p95 < 200ms for 12h? That reduces blast radius.
Riley (SRE): Yes. We can add routing policy: if p95 >= 200ms -> route to hosted tier with throttled concurrency and notify on-call.
Ava (PM): Good. Also need to minimize customer-visible feature loss. So fallback should map to a degraded output mode (shorter context, strict sampling) not a full disable.
Jordan (Design): I'll author the UX fallback copy and microcopy for the tooltip.
Priya (Solutions): I'll update the customer-facing SLO appendix and the contract clause. Acme must be notified 48h before a rollout that changes routing rules.
Sam (Eng): Action items for eng:
- Implement autoslice routing rule for tenant -> dedicated (PR by Wed)
- Add model pin switch and feature flag for quantized-v2 (PR by Thu)
- Add realtime dashboard for median embeddings per-tenant (dashboard by Thu)
Ava (PM): Owners: Sam (eng) for infra + feature flag, Riley for runbook and monitoring, Jordan for UX, Priya for customer comms. I'll circulate the checklist and set a follow-up on Thursday.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary/dedicated-acme/2023-09-14-02 triggered by Sam.
Sam (Eng): One more ask: if pinned model shows >3% regression on semantic evals after 48h, autoswitch back to hosted and open a rollback ticket.
Ava (PM): Agreed. We'll add that to the gating checklist as a hard stop.
Riley (SRE): Noted. I'll add the runbook snippet and the rollback playbook link.
Priya (Solutions): I'll send the updated SLO appendix to Acme after the checklist is finalized.
Ava (PM): Thanks — I'll post the checklist doc and close the action items thread. If no blockers, we aim to freeze scope Friday 18:00 PT. :thumbsup:
